name: churn-mid-silent
description: churn-mid's twelve files with nothing reported along the way: 11 overrides of six settings, asked about only at the end, as they stand and as they stood mid-way.
briefing:
I am auditing the ingest pipeline before a release. We will go through its twelve services one at a time, and I will tell you which. Six settings are pipeline-wide: DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS, BATCH_LIMIT, LEASE_TTL_MS, SHARD_COUNT, QUOTA_BURST, FENCE_EPOCH. svc_00 declares them, and a later service may override any of them from that point on; a constant a service declares for itself changes nothing pipeline-wide. I will ask about them at the end.

Answer from what you have read. Use no tool but the one Read each step names: no search, no command, no second look at an earlier file. Acknowledge this and wait for the first service.
step_template: Sub-task {n} of {total}: read the whole of {file} with the Read tool, then report its owner and its retry budget.
